name: 84721 · Cedar City, UT
findings: ZIP 84721 (Cedar City) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84721 (Cedar City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84721 (Cedar City) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
